sibling_sites_exist_JUDGEMENT: yes: sibling advisories GHSA-5hh8 and GHSA-rcqc fixed the same missing view check on other deserialisation paths
entry_point_GUESS: Library API: ObjectMapper.readerWithView(View).readValue(json) for a class with a creator parameter carrying @JsonView and @JsonTypeInfo(include=EXTERNAL_PROPERTY)
flaw_one_line: The active @JsonView filter is applied to ordinary bean properties but not to creator properties handled through the external-type-id path, so a view-restricted constructor parameter is populated from attacker JSON.
tempting_wrong_fix_JUDGEMENT: Add creatorProp.visibleInView(activeView) in the BeanDeserializer branch the advisory names; values are buffered by ExternalTypeHandler and assigned later in complete(), so the restricted property is still populated. The over-broad variant (skip every external-type-id property when a view is active) breaks view-visible properties.
why_hard_or_why_control_JUDGEMENT: S1: the same view check must hold on every path that can set a property (regular, creator, unwrapped, external type id; two earlier advisories were the same gap elsewhere). S2: the advisory points at BeanDeserializer, the fix lands in ExternalTypeHandler where values are buffered and completed. S3: the view filter existed and was simply not consulted on this path.
caveats: metrics describe the largest of 2 fetched fix commits; Two fix commits referenced (2.x and 3.x branches).
